605:t_031:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then I will open your eyes.」

605:t_032:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The target is $c. We will punish them.」

605:t_032:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Do you still intend to underestimate them?」

605:t_032:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have always merely chosen the best course of action for them and the world.」

605:t_032:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now, $c. Show me you can live up to my expectations.」

605:t_032:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Are you giving us more of your usual condescending taunts?!」

605:t_032:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's about time we made you talk! Tell us who you are and what you want!」

605:t_032:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am ready at any time. All that remains is whether you can rise to that level.」

605:t_032:13.en:
$n
「Then, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! I'll make you tell us everything right here!」

605:t_033:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We can't get any damage through. Is this the same as those black $$アンゲロイ$$s?!」

605:t_033:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Not a bad observation. Fighting you really does bring me joy.」

605:t_033:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It makes me want your cooperation even more.」

605:t_034:1.en:
???
「Your disgusting sunny attitude hasn't changed a bit.」

605:t_035:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「This time I'm finishing you off for good, you piece of shit.」

605:t_035:1.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$! $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$?!」

605:t_035:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Long time no see, Imitation Boy...」

605:t_035:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'd like to say that, but it seems your machine has already surpassed my $$ジェミニア#robot$$.」

605:t_035:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm stubbornly clinging to a life of disgrace.」

605:t_035:6.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But you used the pride of the $$ジェミナイド$$s without permission, then tossed it aside when you didn't need it anymore...」

605:t_035:8.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't worry about it, lady. I'm in no position to criticize anyone else.」

605:t_035:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Have you come to fight us again?」

605:t_035:10.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I've got plenty to say to you lot. But first... I deal with him.」

605:t_035:11.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm no longer with $$サイデリアル$$ or $$ジェミニス$$...」

605:t_035:12.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But you, of all people, I can't forgive, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

605:t_035:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「How pathetic, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$. Your $$スフィア$$ was taken and you lost the woman you loved most, yet you still fight.」

605:t_035:14.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm sorry to 《$$アンナロッタ$$》, but now there are other girls I love more than anything.」

605:t_035:15.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「For their sake too, I'll defeat you with my own hands...!」

605:t_035:17.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「That's how it is, $n. I won't ask you for help, and I have no intention of helping you either.」

605:t_035:18.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'll do whatever I damn well please!」

605:t_035:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$, $n... $$アウストラリス$$, $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$... And $$アサキム$$, $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

605:t_035:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「None of you understand anything.」

605:t_036:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「As I thought, using $$リザレクション$$ twice is a strain.」

605:t_037:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I won't let you escape.」

605:t_038:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You understand too, don't you, $$アサキム$$? That defeating me here is futile.」

605:t_038:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Don't think everything will go as you wish forever.」

605:t_038:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I see... You intend to make me show my hand here.」

605:t_038:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Very well. I'll indulge that cheap provocation.」

605:t_039:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is that... $$アスクレプス$$' true form...?!」

605:t_039:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$! This is what you wanted to see!」

605:t_041:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Death means nothing to him. You all know that too, don't you?」

605:t_041:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's not something you say with a smile.」

605:t_041:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... This is $$ヘリオース$$. My wings.」

605:t_041:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「It bears the name of the sun god...」

605:t_041:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We will meet again, $c. With your power, the universe can be saved.」

605:t_041:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I look forward to seeing you advance along the path of $$シンカ$$.」

605:t_042:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He used the word '$$シンカ$$', but its meaning seems different from what we mean by evolution.」

605:t_042:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Using a word like that... Is he one of humanity's overseers, the ones $$エルガン・ローディック$$ described...?」

605:t_042:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But he said humanity's overseers were $$サイデリアル$$.」

605:t_042:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$... Tell us what you know.」

605:t_042:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I don't owe you that.」

605:t_042:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $n. I've no intention of playing friends with you lot.」

605:t_042:8.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「If you're useful, I'll simply use you.」

605:t_042:10.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Remember this. You're the man who took my $$スフィア$$.」

605:t_042:11.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「If you can't master it, next time I'll take that $$スフィア$$ back from you.」

605:t_043:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Right now... he's at least not our enemy.」

605:t_043:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can tell he's changed a little... I don't sense resignation in him now.」

605:t_043:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In the end, we still don't know who $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ really is...」

605:t_043:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Before we worry about things we don't understand, there's an enemy we have to defeat.」

605:t_044:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ has lurked in the shadows of many worlds' histories and controlled humanity...」
